from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialAssetReport(BaseModel):
    """A recorded financial asset figure from a single document's financial statements."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reporting the financial statement")
    asset_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as reported (e.g., 'Total Current Assets', 'Total Assets')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the asset reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period date (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_asset_reports: list[FinancialAssetReport]
